apps.name: CubeBrowser
apps.author: Arial-Bold
apps.short: Web browser with HTTPS, downloads and MIDI music
apps.long: A web browser with HTTPS, pictures, tables and forms, downloads to the SD card and MIDI music; a Game Boy Advance can act as the music remote. Needs a network adapter. Settings, bookmarks and logins are kept on update.

apps.name: Snes9x GX
apps.author: dborth and contributors
apps.long: A Super Nintendo / Super Famicom emulator built on Snes9x, with a menu for loading games, save states and controls. Put your ROMs (.smc, .sfc or zipped) in sd:/snes9xgx/roms.

apps.name: FCE Ultra GX
apps.author: dborth and contributors
apps.short: NES / Famicom emulator with Famicom Disk System support
apps.long: An NES / Famicom emulator built on FCE Ultra, with a menu for games, save states and controls. Put ROMs (.nes, .fds, .unf, .nsf or zipped) in sd:/fceugx/roms, and disksys.rom for Disk System games in sd:/fceugx.

apps.name: GCMM
apps.author: suloku
apps.short: Memory card manager: back up and restore saves
apps.long: GameCube Memory Manager copies saves between the memory cards and the SD card: back up a whole card or single saves, restore them, delete saves, and fix or format a card. Backups go to the SD card.

apps.name: gcradio
apps.author: RyoSaeba89
apps.short: Internet radio: Icecast/SHOUTcast MP3, AAC and Opus
apps.long: Plays Icecast and SHOUTcast internet radio (MP3, AAC, Opus) over the Broadband Adapter. Type a stream address on the console and it is remembered. HTTPS stations also need gcradio-ca.pem in sd:/apps/gcradio; see the homepage.

apps.name: Flashcube
apps.author: Arial-Bold
apps.short: Photo viewer with albums, slideshows and favourites
apps.long: Browse your photos as thumbnails by year, folder or favourites, with slideshows set to MIDI music and doodles. Photos go in sd:/DCIM as a camera stores them, songs in sd:/midi. Settings and favourites are kept on update.

apps.name: CubeVerse
apps.author: Arial-Bold
apps.long: Read and post in Juxtaposition, Pretendo Network's Miiverse revival: Yeahs, comments, drawings, follows. Needs a network adapter and a Pretendo Network ID. Unofficial; not made or supported by Pretendo Network.

apps.name: GC Station
apps.author: antho13otz
apps.short: Media centre: music, web radio, photos, podcasts (French)
apps.long: A media centre (formerly GC-MP3) in French: music from sd:/mp3 (MP3, FLAC, OGG, AAC), web radio, podcasts, photos, videos, files, weather, news and a phone remote over the Broadband Adapter. Settings live in sd:/gc-mp3.

apps.name: Swiss
apps.author: emu_kidid and contributors
apps.short: Loader and multitool: games, homebrew, memory cards
apps.long: The GameCube loader: boots games and homebrew from SD, GC Loader, FlippyDrive, network and more, with patches and cheats. If yours boots from sd:/ipl.dol, the browser offers to replace it. Other boot methods: update by hand.

apps.name: Indigo
apps.author: spencernorton
apps.short: Fork of Swiss with a new interface: animated cube Home, poster library
apps.long: An unofficial fork of Swiss with a new interface: animated glass cube, poster library, menu music. Installs to sd:/apps only. To boot it at power-on, copy files by hand: norvitech.com/indigo/guide/install. Games go in sd:/games.

apps.name: Swiss 3D (fork)
apps.author: portlandhodl
apps.short: Fork of Swiss with a 3D interface, cover flow and network streaming
apps.long: An unofficial fork of Swiss rebuilt in 3D: glass cubes, cover flow, menu sounds, screen recording and faster network loading. Installs to sd:/apps only, separate from Swiss. To boot it at power-on, copy it by hand from the homepage.

apps.name: Cube Menu
apps.author: hudsonbrendon
apps.short: Game menu with a 3D shelf of cases, clips and themes; games start through Swiss
apps.long: A 3D shelf of game cases with clips and themes; games start through Swiss. Needs Swiss's boot.dol at sd:/swiss/boot.dol (sd:/apps/swiss is not used) and games in sd:/games/<Name>/game.iso. Covers and clips need a computer tool.

apps.name: DOOM GC
apps.author: fromdustz
apps.short: Port of id Software's DOOM source. Bring your own WAD file
apps.long: No game data is included: put your own WAD file in sd:/doom from a computer, next to doom.cfg. id Software's 1997 DOOM source ported to the GameCube, with saving and a settings menu. LAN play is untested.

apps.name: GC Homebrew Hub Browser
apps.author: GC Homebrew Hub
apps.short: This app store: browse, install, update and remove homebrew
apps.long: The program you are using: lists the homebrew in its catalogs, and installs, updates, starts and removes apps on the SD card. An update keeps settings, sources and the log. Start it again afterwards to run the new version.
